summaries.Romania: Romania faces political uncertainty as PSD leadership meets today to decide whether to support PM-designate Siegfried Mureșan's government, with internal party divisions threatening either government formation or early elections. Meanwhile, Călin Georgescu, the pro-Russian presidential candidate, was arrested by DIICOT in a fraud investigation involving €1.1 million.
summaries.Healthcare: The radiopharmaceuticals sector consolidates as ITM Isotope Technologies and Telix Pharmaceuticals merge, while healthcare innovation accelerates with AI-powered clinical tools, expanded wearable integration in care models, and growing investment in precision medicine startups despite ongoing challenges in virtual care adoption.
summaries.Tech: Apple's AI Siri rollout faces user frustration despite improvements, the radiopharmaceutical and precision health sectors see major consolidation and funding rounds, and broader AI industry scrutiny grows around development pace and safety concerns amid rapid feature deployment.

items.title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets

items.title: ARPA-H launches SPECTRA program, new autism research initiative

items.line: ARPA-H's new SPECTRA program targets autism risk identification and intervention at scale, addressing a critical gap in early diagnosis and personalized treatment.

items.title: Oura, Counsel Health join CMS ACCESS model to test whether wearables and AI can improve chronic care at scale
items.snippet: Counsel Health, an AI-native primary care company, plans to participate in CMS' ACCESS Model under the early cardio-kidney-metabolic track, with smart ring maker Oura serving as the preferred wearable partner.
items.line: CMS ACCESS Model testing wearables (Oura rings) plus AI-native primary care could establish scalable models for chronic disease management in under-resourced populations.

items.title: Sentara Health pilots GW RhythmX's AI precision care platform to support emerging primary care models
items.snippet: Not-for-profit health system Sentara Health is moving beyond administrative automation to test artificial intelligence-powered clinical care directly during primary care visits.
items.line: Sentara Health's deployment of AI precision care during primary visits signals healthcare's shift from administrative automation to real-time clinical decision support.

Apple will pay an estimated $25 per eligible iPhone to eligible customers, who can submit a claim via the settlement website between September 21
items.line: Apple's $250M Siri AI settlement payout reflects legal and user trust risks from delayed feature launches in the competitive AI assistant market.
